title: lifecycle-economics-hook: tenant lifecycle-driven batching/caching and quant profile deployer
author: Maya Patel
description: Add a tenant lifecycle economics hook and a deployer that automatically adjusts batching, cache presets, and quantization profiles when tenant-level lifecycle events (onboard, scale-up, scale-down, dormant, churn-risk) are emitted. Motivation: customers repeatedly ask for safe automatic defaults that adapt as usage patterns change; manual operations and one-off scripts create drift and missed savings. This PR introduces: 1) an extensible lifecycle hook service (packages/econ_hook) that subscribes to tenant lifecycle events from the control plane and produces deterministic 'prescription' objects describing batch shapes, cache TTLs, and quant profile candidates; 2) a safe Deployer (tooling/econ_deployer) that performs dry-run validations against tenant SLOs, runs local sims (prefill/synthetic traces) and only applies changes after passing rollback-time and quality-guard checks; 3) a CLI preview command (rwi econ preview --tenant <id>) for solutions and SREs to simulate policy changes and see estimated unit-econ delta; 4) a lightweight telemetry bridge that emits delta metrics required by Optimize (optimize.unit_econ.proposed_delta) and flags for quality regressions (optimize.quality.flag). The design intentionally separates prescription generation from execution and includes a staging canary that applies changes to non-critical capacity lanes first. Safety: policies are constrained by tenant policy bounds, opt-in tenant tags, and an explicit 'accept' workflow for major quant profile changes. This update includes unit and integration tests, documentation for operators, and migration logic for existing default profiles.
commits: feat(econ_hook): add lifecycle event listener and prescription generator
feat(deployer): implement dry-run and staged apply workflows
chore(cli): add rwi econ preview and apply commands
test: add synthetic prefills and unit-econ regression tests
docs: operator guide and runbook for lifecycle economics
fix: tighten policy validation and rollback window
review_conversation: Liam Chen: Please add a defensive check that prevents deploying quant profiles that change numeric formats (float32->int8) without a fallback model variant. Maya: Good catch, added a gating check in deployer.stager and unit tests to cover the fallback path.

Aisha Roberts: The preview CLI should surface estimated latency/95p impact. Maya: Added the estimate column computed from batch shape + kv-presence model and included a note in docs on estimation variance.

Diego Morales: Runbook should include recovery steps if telemetry signals false-positive quality alerts. Maya: Expanded docs/operator/econ-lifecycle-runbook.md with a rollback checklist and emergency revert CLI.
Aisha Roberts: CI integration test flaked once for prefills on small instances. Maya: Increased timeout and pinned the trace seed to stabilize the test; re-ran CI.
Liam Chen: Approved after addressing the gating checks and adding the canary stage logs.
ci_log_summary: All CI checks green after second run. Integration flake resolved by test stabilization. No performance regressions detected in batcher microbench harness.
release_notes: Introduce tenant lifecycle economics hook and safe deployer that auto-suggests and can apply batching, cache, and quant defaults based on tenant events. Includes rwi econ preview/apply CLI, operator runbook, and telemetry deltas for Optimize. Rollout: gradual; enabled for internal tenants by default and opt-in for customer accounts.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag econ.lifecycle_hook=true in control-plane and ensure telemetry ingestion for optimize.unit_econ.* metrics. Run 'rwi econ preview --tenant <id>' before applying in production. For emergency revert: 'rwi econ revert --tenant <id> --to <snapshot>'
risk_assessment: Low-medium. Most changes are advisory (preview) until deployer is used. Deployer enforces policy bounds and staged canaries. Major quant profile changes require explicit acceptance and fallback model variants.
testing_summary: Added 6 unit tests covering prescription generation and policy validation, 3 integration scenarios (onboard -> scale-up, sustained microburst, dormant wake-up) with synthetic traces, and telemetry sanity checks. Prefill sim harness used to estimate cost/latency delta.
deployment_plan: Phase 1: internal tenants only; watch optimize.unit_econ.* and quality flags for 48h. Phase 2: enable for opt-in customer tenants. Phase 3: gradual auto-apply with 5% ramp every 24h.
footnotes: This PR focuses on orchestrating existing building blocks (prefill sim, batcher policy adapter, quant catalog) rather than introducing new quant kernels. It paves the way for future closed-loop autotuning but remains manual-by-default for safety.
